errors.evidence: The x-axis category labels in the figure are CLS, TextCNN, LSAN, FL, RFL, CB, DB, HTTN, LACO, FLEM, and TextCNN-CB. The description incorrectly lists DLS instead of CLS and GB instead of CB, and it also implies there are 12 models when there are 11.

errors.text_span: 图表采用堆叠条形图的方式
errors.evidence: The figure shows grouped bars for each model, not stacked bars. Each model has multiple adjacent bars corresponding to different methods.

errors.text_span: 展示了四种方法（Teacher、Self-Training、PST）以及一种未在图例中明确指出的方法（可能是模型自带的方法或默认对比方法）
errors.evidence: The legend shows exactly three methods: Teacher, Self-Training, and PST. There is no fourth unlabeled method in the chart.
For FLEM, the bars are around 50, 51, and 54; none exceed 60. The only bar above 60 is for TextCNN-CB (PST), around 65.
The lowest bar for the first model is around 31–34 depending on method, not specifically 30, and the model label itself is incorrect (CLS, not DLS).
The description does not mention that the bars are grouped by model with three adjacent bars per group, nor does it correctly describe the legend-to-pattern mapping for the three methods.
